desc: 霓虹紫蓝场充电台式空气循环扇详情页套图
leaf: 充电式台式空气循环扇
name: 四季循环广角送风台式循环扇款

shots.intent: 用霓虹紫蓝暗场仰视整机压住首屏，气流光束与三枚六角徽标一秒给出核心主张拿下点击。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline band plus one short label inside each of the three stacked hexagon badges, all placeholders

shots.intent: 把续航、调速、扇叶与电机四条主张压成一眼可读的玻璃图标阵，承接首屏建立性能预期。
shots.textZone: top headline band plus one label per tile, placeholders only

shots.intent: 微距交代密集放射导流格栅与内层扇叶的实体结构，用工艺细节代替口号式主张。
shots.textZone: one badge caption at the right, placeholder only

shots.intent: 用一列等高胶囊行把档位递进的风力差可视化，让买家看懂机制而不是读数字。
shots.textZone: one reserved gear button per row kept empty plus one caption placeholder per row

shots.intent: 后侧机位交代摇头支架与后壳筋位，再用流线索面证明导流风罩把风送得宽。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline plus one sub-line placeholder

shots.intent: 同机位双幅对照窄直吹与宽扫风，用虚线摆幅弧证明广角覆盖而不是喊口号。
shots.textZone: one caption pill per panel plus a top headline, all placeholders

shots.intent: 把循环扇放回夜里床头送风的真实语境，让用户完成自我代入并理解安静使用预期。
shots.textZone: upper-left wall area, one headline placeholder only

shots.intent: 侧面微距交代圆盘底座、细立柱与触控位成型，把做工与操作位置讲成可见事实。
保留源页规格版式消除参数疑虑，但所有数值单元格一律留空由用户回填，绝不编造。
shots.textZone: one headline placeholder above the card column; row labels reserved as placeholders and every value cell left blank

shots.intent: 以整机加空按钮位收口整页，把转化动作留给下游回填而不是虚构促销话术。
shots.textZone: upper headline band plus one blank reserved button shape at the lower centre, no rendered wording on the button

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous neon studio field only: deep indigo falloff #1B1D4B at the frame edges opening into an electric blue-violet backdrop #383B8E with vertical fluted light columns; the same indigo-violet palette is transposed into a real dim bedroom for the single night lifestyle screen; every infographic screen reuses the same field with frosted glass rounded cards and pill rows #4A5BE0; no third background, no white studio, no outdoor daylight
style.direction: neon electric-appliance commerce, indigo studio field with cyan airflow graphics
style.iconSystem: rounded-square frosted glass tiles #4A5BE0 holding a frosted inner square #F2F4FF with one solid blue silhouette glyph, plus hexagon outline badges with a white hairline edge; one glyph or one badge per claim, no illustration shading, no line-art mixed with filled glyphs
style.lightingSystem: cool neon studio key from the upper right at 5500K, thin rim separating the shell edge, volumetric light beams raking from behind, low-contrast fill on the shadow side, glossy floor reflections on the dark indigo floor #23265E and exactly one honest contact shadow under the round base, no warm cast, no hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent neon electric-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a deep indigo field #1B1D4B, an electric blue-violet studio backdrop #383B8E, frosted glass blue cards #4A5BE0 and one airflow cyan accent #22D3EE, with all Chinese copy in white #FFFFFF; cool neon studio light keyed from the upper right at 5500K with a thin rim separating the shell, volumetric light beams from behind, glossy dark indigo floor reflections #23265E and one honest contact shadow under the base on every screen; a single continuous studio field for product screens, the same indigo-violet palette transposed into a real dim room for the one night lifestyle screen, and frosted glass rounded cards or pill rows for every infographic screen; airflow always drawn the same way, as thin white streamlines with solid cyan arrowheads leaving the grille face; modern geometric sans-serif only, two-line Chinese headlines, one oversized ghost outline latin word as the only background lettering, hexagon outline badges and rounded-square glass glyph tiles with a frosted inner square; stable product scale, the same front three-quarter head-tilt family across hero screens and one constant light direction across matched panels; every gear button, degree marker, badge label, parameter value cell and call-to-action button is left blank as a reserved placeholder; no colour palette changes, no warm or orange cast, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting between matched panels, no invented numbers or units, no rendered digits, no brand marks, no QR codes or promotional corner badges.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no warm, orange or gold cast
no white seamless studio background and no outdoor daylight
no mixed fonts and no filled 3D text
no random backgrounds between matched panels
no inconsistent lighting or light direction between panels
no invented numbers, units, percentages or decibel figures
no rendered digits, brand marks, QR codes or promotional corner badges
no mismatched icon styles and no more than one glyph per claim
style.presentationRules: one front three-quarter head-tilt hero family held at constant scale; airflow always drawn the same way, as thin white streamlines with solid cyan #22D3EE arrowheads leaving the radial grille face; identical crop distance and light direction across matched comparison panels; every gear button, degree marker, badge label, parameter value cell and button label stays blank as a reserved placeholder
style.surfaceSystem: the unit rests directly on the glossy dark indigo floor #23265E; only the base-and-column macro screen may raise it on one pale matte stone slab #EDEAE2; the lifestyle screen uses a matte dark cabinet top with pale linen bedding #E7E4EF; no oak, no rattan, no marble counter elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, two-line Chinese headlines in white #FFFFFF, one small-caps latin kicker, one oversized ghost outline latin word as the only background lettering, one thin white rule under each headline, three-layer copy budget with every word carried as a placeholder
